QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Root Cause
QuestInfo.0: Eremose has some information about your recent visit to Ellinel Fairy Academy.
QuestInfo.1: A powerful mole monster has been detected near Ellinel Fairy Academy. To further your training, locate and defeat the Mole King.
QuestInfo.2: You've defeated the Mole King in Ellinel Fairy Academy, and you've got a sneaking suspicion this monster might be the cause of the problems in Ellinel.
